answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the knoll queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1621 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. The copper index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Verification alone takes 11 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
